title: Add an AI chat feature to your iOS app (Claude / GPT)
footer: Ajay Girolkar · Senior iOS Engineer · 11 yrs · Claude Agent SDK
hero_headline:
Ship an AI feature
inside your iOS app
hero_sub: Streaming chat, tool calling, conversation history. Built native in SwiftUI against the Claude or OpenAI API, with your key kept off the device.
grid_title: What a shipped AI surface looks like
deliverables: Streaming responses, token by token, no spinner freeze
Tool use / function calling wired to your app's own data
API key handled server-side or in Keychain, never hardcoded
Cancel, retry, and rate-limit handling that actually works
Markdown and code-block rendering in the chat bubble
Prompt caching to cut your per-call token cost
Loom walkthrough of the model calls and cost model

process.title: Requirements
process.body: You send repo access, your API provider, and what the AI should be able to do. Clock starts here.

process.title: Transport
process.body: Streaming client, error handling and cancellation land first. The hard part, done early.

process.title: Surface
process.body: Chat UI, history, and tool calls wired to your data. You get a build to try.

process.title: Ship
process.body: Cost review, prompt tuning, revision round, and a note on what to watch in production.

tiers.name: Premium
items: Proxy endpoint so no key ships
Unit tests on the model layer

fit_title: Is this the right project for you?
fit_good: You have an existing iOS app and want AI inside it
You already have, or can get, a Claude or OpenAI API key
You want native SwiftUI, not a web view wrapper
You care what each call costs you per user
fit_bad: You want a model trained or fine-tuned on your data
You need the backend or proxy service designed from zero
You expect on-device inference with no API
The feature is not defined yet
